name: Katie's of Smithtown
description: A historic two-level Irish-style pub on Smithtown's Main Street, famous for its ghost stories. It has full bands on weekends, a Tuesday jam, a Wednesday open mic and karaoke.

dancing.notes: Full bands play on Friday and Saturday nights. The basement has hosted DJ dance nights, such as the Velvet Fang goth dance club. We could not confirm how much room there is to dance on band nights.

evidence.note: Venue guide: two floors, a patio, full bands on Friday and Saturday, a Tuesday solo or jam night and a Wednesday open mic.
